name: prompt-refiner
description: Turn rough prompts into clear requests with context, constraints, and success criteria.

interface.shortDescription: Make prompts clear, precise, and actionable
interface.longDescription: Turns rough prompts into clear, self-contained requests. It preserves your intent and constraints, adds relevant context and completion criteria, and asks focused questions when missing details would change the request. It refines prompts; it carries out the resulting task only if you also ask it to.
defaultPrompt: Sharpen this prompt while preserving my intent:
